subject: Technical briefing — reschedule pending vendor onboarding & security checklist
messages:
From: Jenna Park <jenna@healthsol.com>
To: olga.petrov@redwood.com
Cc: alex.lim@healthsol.com
Date: Fri, 28 Jul 2028 15:00:00 -0700
Subject: Request to pause technical briefing scheduled Aug 2

Hi Olga,

Thanks again for scheduling the technical briefing for Aug 2 — our team is looking forward to it. Quick update from procurement/security: we just kicked off HealthSol's vendor intake process and our security team has requested we complete a questionnaire and sign an updated NDA before the CTO attends any deep-dive. The intake is blocking any technical access they require.

Given that, would Redwood be open to holding the session until we clear those items? I expect the questionnaire will take a few business days but there's also a travel window for our CTO next week which may push availability.

We don’t want to waste your engineering team’s time if we can’t provide the right attendees or grant temporary access. Proposed: put the Aug 2 slot on hold; I can follow up with a clearer timeline by Monday.

Apologies for the short notice — trying to avoid last-minute no-shows.

Best,
Jenna Park
Head of Product Ops
HealthSol

Attachments: none
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Jenna Park <jenna@healthsol.com>
Cc: jonas.weber@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 28 Jul 2028 16:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request to pause technical briefing scheduled Aug 2

Hi Jenna — thanks for the heads up and totally understand.

Short answer: yes, we can put the Aug 2 briefing on hold until HealthSol completes the intake. To keep momentum, I’ve attached our standard security questionnaire and a draft NDA for review. When you have a read on timing, can you share:

- whether your security team needs a sandbox or sample logs for the questionnaire answers
- an expected date range for CTO availability (you mentioned travel)
- the legal contact to route the NDA to, and whether DocuSign or a PDF exchange is preferred

Tentative scheduling options if intake clears quickly: week of Aug 9 or week of Aug 16. If your CTO isn’t back till later, we can target the week of Aug 21 — happy to lock a tentative hold and confirm once the paperwork is in.

Next steps / asks for HealthSol:
- Complete the attached Redwood_Security_Questionnaire_v1.xlsx (security)
- Sign or redline the NDA-draft-HealthSol.pdf and return to ben.carter@redwood.com (legal)
- Share any vendor intake form from your side so we can align (we’ll pre-populate answers where helpful)

Jonas (AE) — can you hold two alternate slots (Aug 9 AM PT and Aug 22 AM PT) on our calendar until Jenna confirms? Ben — looping you for NDA and questionnaire support.

Thanks, and apologies to your team for the administrative overhead — we’ll keep it light.

— Olga
Olga Petrov
Principal Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0187
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood_Security_Questionnaire_v1.xlsx, NDA-draft-HealthSol.pdf

Cc: Jenna Park <jenna@healthsol.com>, alex.lim@healthsol.com
Date: Sat, 29 Jul 2028 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request to pause technical briefing scheduled Aug 2

Hi Olga / team,

We received your questionnaire and NDA — thanks for sending them over. Quick status:

- We’ll begin the questionnaire this morning. I’ve attached our vendor intake PDF (HealthSol_Vendor_Intake_Form.pdf) which lists the fields we need back.
- Our CTO (Alex Lim) is traveling until Aug 17 and is the primary attendee for the architecture portion; without him the session would be limited.
- We prefer to sign NDAs through our legal portal; I’ve cc’d legal (jparks-legal@healthsol.com) on threads where needed.

Given the travel window, Aug 2 won’t work for the deep-dive. Realistic earliest window is the week of Aug 21; I’ll update by Mon with a more precise date if we finish the intake earlier.

We appreciate the flexibility.

— HealthSol Security
security operations
sec@healthsol.com

Attachment: HealthSol_Vendor_Intake_Form.pdf
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Jenna Park <jenna@healthsol.com>, sec@healthsol.com
Cc: jonas.weber@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 30 Jul 2028 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request to pause technical briefing scheduled Aug 2

Thanks for the quick updates, everyone — makes sense to align for the CTO. Per HealthSol’s note, we’ll move the deep architecture session to the week of Aug 21.

Confirmed interim plan:
- Redwood holds Aug 22, 2028 at 10:00 AM PT as our target slot (please confirm availability) — I’ll send a calendar invite once Jenna confirms.
- Action items for HealthSol before the session:
  • Complete and return Redwood_Security_Questionnaire_v1.xlsx (security)
  • Upload or send the signed NDA (NDA-draft-HealthSol.pdf) to ben.carter@redwood.com or sign via the DocuSign link below
  • Provide the preferred technical point-of-contact and SSO contact for provisioning (email + role)
  • If you want a sandbox or sample logs, list the specific data types required on the questionnaire and we’ll prep an access plan

Jonas — please hold Aug 22 10:00 AM PT on the calendar tentatively (invite attached). Ben — I’ll route any NDA redlines to you. Jenna / HealthSol security — appreciate a confirmation on the date and any legal contact for DocuSign routing.

Helpful links: HubSpot deal page (https://hub.redwood.com/deals/HS-2028-Q3-042), DocuSign (https://docusign.com/redirect/ABC123-sign)

If anything changes, we’ll pivot, but this should avoid scheduling churn and make sure the CTO can attend.

Best,
Olga
Principal Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.com
